Check Engine SEO 1.3.164

**Check Engine is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A free audit now leads with the AI search crawler result.* The free result shows one problem in full, with its fix. When your robots.txt blocks the AI search crawlers (the ones that build the indexes AI assistants cite from) and the site is not also shut to Google, that is the problem the free result now shows first. Before, it showed whichever problem ranked first overall. When Google is blocked too, that still comes first, because it is the bigger fix.
- *Which problem is first changes only in that one case.* The score, the problem counts, the ranked plan and the paid result are unchanged.
- Nothing else changed in how audits, reports or licences work. Your licence key, settings and past reports carry over as before.

99 checks across 13 areas.
